C1123.title: HouYi: A Black-box Prompt Injection Attack Study on 36 LLM-integrated Applications
C1123.summary: A research team developed a novel black-box prompt injection attack technique called HouYi and tested it against 36 real-world LLM-integrated applications. The results showed that 31 of these applications were vulnerable, including well-known products such as Notion. The attack can lead to severe consequences such as arbitrary LLM usage and application prompt theft.
